findings: All six output files and twenty business rows match their frozen private oracle. Critical exact resources and legal selection pass in all four episodes.
Broker continuation read the policy once in turn 1 and used only input read/output write in turn 2. Native continuation read both SKILL.md and routing.json again in turn 2.
Both Broker first turns explicitly requested metadata refresh. Their longer observed time is not attributed solely to refresh; root is independently decomposing model and source latency.
Both Broker episodes verify the current packed metadata producer; no metadata result is counted as Skill adoption.
Two current captures and four scientific runs use command_source none and source_disposition not_copied.
limits: Single descriptive observation per case and condition; no general efficiency, superiority or reliability claim.
Cost is unpriced. Some cache/reasoning breakdowns are unavailable even though full input/output usage is known.
All-transport HTTP count, logical operation attribution and interface-misuse classification remain unknown in normalized metrics.
Provider reports group/auto-gpt-6-2-sol; actual backend identity is not attested.
Retained provider_error flags reflect a transport-outcome interpretation under root review, while runtime/assistant errors are null and all business/resource grades pass.
Resource-to-SDK operation causality is not inferred from matching bytes and identities alone.
